lines: A module is delivered more than once inside a single page:
photos-main: 21,297 B beyond the first copy, focus-trap 13,656 B, @floating-ui/core 5,760 B, @nextcloud/paths 738 B.
photos-dashboard: 1,490 B beyond the first copy, @nextcloud/paths 738 B, @nextcloud/initial-state 441 B, generated by vite 197 B.
photos-public: 1,392 B beyond the first copy, @nextcloud/paths 738 B, @nextcloud/initial-state 441 B, generated by vite 197 B.
moment, 292,536 B on the photos-main page: carries its locale data; luxon and date-fns are a fraction of it.
vite-plugin-node-polyfills, 57,703 B on the photos-main page: Node APIs polyfilled into a browser bundle.
24 B in 2 pieces of 2 files have no owner: no mapping covers them, and the code matches no file of a neighbouring module, of the app, or of the bundler and its plugins.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (152 packages, 969 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
No bundler chunk in build is left without something that loads it.
